FOR BUSINESS BROKERS AND M&A ADVISERS

A Pre-Market Resource for Owners Who Are Not Ready to Launch

The hardest referral to handle is often the owner who may be a good future seller but is too early, too unprepared, or too uncertain for a formal engagement. Exit Desk gives that owner a structured buyer-side read without competing for the transaction.

Join the partner networkReview sample reports
THE NO-CONFLICT WINDOW

Exit Desk sits before market execution.

Too early

The owner is 1–5 years out and needs priorities, not a process. Exit Desk converts vague interest into a specific readiness plan.

Too fragile

Owner dependency, weak reporting, concentration, or undocumented contracts would undermine the story today. The audit identifies what to fix first.

Too price-anchored

The owner expects a multiple without understanding buyer type, earnings quality, structure, or risk discounts. Scenarios make assumptions visible.

Too uncertain

The owner has not decided whether to sell. A flat-fee report creates clarity without forcing an engagement or market launch.

WHAT COMES BACK TO THE INTERMEDIARY

A better-prepared future client

  • Understands why different buyer types may value the business differently
  • Has seen the likely diligence pressure points before market exposure
  • Can discuss add-backs, dependency, concentration, and recurring revenue with specificity
  • Knows that headline value, structure, certainty, and after-tax proceeds are different questions
  • Is more likely to engage at the right time with realistic expectations
CLEAN LANE DIVISION

Prepare first. Execute when ready.

Exit Desk owns

  • Pre-market buyer-lens analysis
  • Indicative valuation scenarios
  • Readiness risks and prioritized actions
  • Education before a formal process

The broker or M&A adviser owns

  • Engagement strategy and market positioning
  • Buyer outreach and competitive process
  • Bid comparison and commercial negotiation
  • Transaction coordination through closing

Exit Desk does not represent sellers, solicit buyers, earn a success fee, or compete for the intermediary’s engagement. Owners already in a live process should work with their transaction team.

TWO-WAY PARTNERSHIP

Refer early owners for preparation. Receive sale-ready referrals when fit and timing align.

Buyer-Lens Audit™ pricing is $199 under $1M revenue and $499 at $1M+. Partners receive $100 per converted client. No minimums or exclusivity; licensing, disclosures, and firm policies remain the partner’s responsibility.
